specs: All passengers will participate in a safety briefing, sign release forms, and, if desired or required, don life jackets. (See below for more information on life jacket requirements.) We’ll then climb aboard, get settled, and off we go!
Parents or guardians are responsible for determining if their minors between the ages of 13-17 must wear a life jacket.
We carry and will provide a life jacket to any passenger wishing to wear one.

policies: What to wear: Sailors should dress for safety, comfort, and weather.
We provide spray jackets if the weather turns or you need an extra layer.
Weather and Cancellation Policy At Tribeca Sailing, we understand that no one wishes to sail in dangerous weather.
The captain of the vessel has sole discretion to cancel a charter due to inclement weather.
Examples of inclement weather include thunderstorms, lightning, excessive or dangerous winds, and sustained heavy rain.
Sailing in imperfect weather is part of the experience.
Weather forecasts are frequently inaccurate, and we ask for your patience with them.
We understand that no one wishes to go sailing in inclement weather.
